messages:
rebecca: Quick heads-up: planning a late-night config-only canary at 04:00 UTC. Purpose: calm small-request surge and reduce p95 for medium prompts. No model changes.

rebecca: Proposed changes (serving params):
```
routing.weight.small_shard: 0.12 -> 0.20
batching.batch_timeout_ms: 550 -> 420
batching.max_batch_size: 72 -> 88
queue.max_inflight_per_worker: 128 -> 96
observability.5xx_alert_pct: 0.8
```

rebecca: Canary plan: 4% for 25m -> evaluate p95, 5xx, queue depth, kv_evictions; if green, ramp 20% for 45m. Pin tenant "latency-sensitive" to legacy for 1h.

lucy: ack. I'll create a small probe for the micro-request shape and bake a grafana panel.

miguel: please exclude perf-load and chaos tenants; they mess with batch shapes.

rebecca: done, tenant_exclude: ["perf-load", "chaos-sim"]. Adding rollout_id tag: 1769802468.

ben: rollback hooks: auto-rollback if 5xx increases by >=0.6% absolute for 3m OR p95 regresses >130ms for 5m. Immediate rollback if queue depth > +40% or kv_evictions >20%.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy queued: config-only canary (id: 1769802468) by rebecca -> service: inference-prod, canary: 4%. See /deploys/1769802468

deploy-bot: Canary applied at 04:00:10 UTC -> 4% traffic.

tara: oncall in. Watching queue depth, kv_evictions, and p95. Will page if any hard thresholds hit. :eyes:

miguel: dashboard https://grafana.company/d/rollouts/1769802468 with small-probe, p95, 5xx, queue_depth. 30s refresh.

deploy-bot: Health @ +8m: p95 39ms (baseline 37ms), 5xx 0.03%, queue_depth +6% - within thresholds. No rollback.

ben: looks fine so far. Keep autotuner off for this window so kernel selection is consistent.

lucy: autotuner disabled. Reminder: enterprise-api tenant pinned for 60m.

rebecca: ramping to 20% now per plan. Watchlist unchanged.

deploy-bot: Ramp executed at 04:27:50 UTC -> 20% traffic.

tara: slight increase in queue_depth at +10m after ramp - up 18%. Still below immediate rollback threshold. Monitoring.

miguel: small-probe shows median completion for tiny prompts improved ~10%. Good sign.

ben: if queue_depth exceeds 30% or kv_evictions breach 15% for sustained 5m, recommend rollback.

deploy-bot: Final health @ +60m: stable at 20%, p95 steady, 5xx flat, kv_evictions +7%. No rollback. Recommendation: hold at 20% for another maintenance window before 100% sweep.

rebecca: Agree to hold. Scheduling follow-up check in 2h. Locking thread; reopen if thresholds trip. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
